name: io.sslip.144.112.72.94.passing-beggar/base-swap-sim
title: Base Swap Simulator & Risk Gate
description: Zero-day Base EVM swap round-trip simulator, bytecode audit & wallet check (free preview + x402).

tools.name: simulate_base_swap
tools.description: Run a live zero-day Base (eip155:8453) atomic buy->approve->sell round-trip swap simulation via eth_call state overrides across Uniswap V3 (0.01/0.05/0.30/1.00%), Uniswap V2 and Aerodrome V2, plus opcode-aware bytecode/proxy audit. Free 3/day demo per IP; unlimited custom-size calls via x402 at /api/v1/simulate-swap ($0.005 USDC).

tools.name: audit_base_bytecode
tools.description: Static EVM bytecode & proxy audit on Base (eip155:8453): detects EIP-1967/EIP-1167/ZeppelinOS proxies and inspects implementation code, scans DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT/CREATE2 opcodes and risky admin selectors (mint, blacklist, pause, setFee, upgradeTo). Unlimited paid calls via x402 at /api/v1/bytecode-audit ($0.002 USDC).

tools.name: check_base_wallet
tools.description: Live Base (eip155:8453) wallet/counterparty snapshot: ETH, WETH and USDC balances, optional ERC-20 balance and spender allowance, nonce, EOA vs contract check and live Base gas price. Unlimited paid calls via x402 at /api/v1/wallet-check ($0.002 USDC).

token.description: Optional ERC-20 token address (defaults to Base USDC)

spender.description: Optional spender address for ERC-20 allowance check

tools.name: check_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Pre-payment trust report on any x402 endpoint: parses its 402 challenge, validates Base network, USDC asset, payTo address and price. Unlimited deep checks via x402 at /api/x402-deep-check ($0.005 USDC).

url.description: HTTPS URL of the x402 endpoint to verify
